abstract: A clinicopathological study of a 42-year-old female with pure gonadal dysgenesis and dysgerminoma was made. At the age of 29, the patient with primary amenorrhea had been evaluated clinically and cytogenetically. (1) The results of cytogenetic studies were X-chromatin positive and revealed a karyotype in peripheral blood leukocytes of 46,XX. (2) Laboratory studies indicated hypergonadotropic hypogonadism and no response of the gonads to the human menopausal gonadotropin stimulation test. (3) At laparotomy, the gonads were streak-like. Pathological examinations of biopsy specimens from both gonads revealed dense, fibrous connective tissue resembling ovarian stroma and no primary follicles. Eleven years after the laparotomy, the patient complained of lower abdominal distention and severe pain, and laparotomy then revealed a 15 X 17-cm right solid adnexal mass occupying the pelvic cavity. The histological diagnosis of tissues from the partially removed tumor was pure dysgerminoma. Second-look operation after Linac X-ray irradiation showed complete remission of the residual tumor. Insofar as we are aware, the present patient represents the first case of dysgerminoma which occurred in the dysgenetic gonads of a phenotypic female with normal 46,XX sex-chromosomal constitutions in peripheral blood leukocytes and the skin fibroblasts although a possibility exists that mosaicism was possibly present but undetected, particularly since the streak gonads were not analyzed chromosomally.
abstract_ja: 46,XX純粋性腺異形成と診断された42歳女性の臨床病理学的検討を行った。29歳時、原発性無月経の評価として染色体検査を行い、核型は46,XXであった。(1)末梢血白血球の細胞遺伝学的検査でX染色質陽性。(2)高ゴナドトロピン性性腺機能低下症。(3)開腹では性腺は線条状で、両側生検では卵巣間質様の線維性結合組織がみられ、一次卵胞は認められなかった。11年後、下腹部膨満と激痛があり、開腹で右付属器に15×17cmの充実性腫瘤を認めた。部分切除組織の病理診断は純粋なディスジャーミノーマ(未分化胚細胞腫)であった。直線加速器によるX線照射後のセカンドルック手術で残存腫瘍は完全寛解していた。知られる限り、本症例は末梢血白血球と皮膚線維芽細胞で正常な46,XX核型を有する表現型女性の異形成性性腺に生じた初のディスジャーミノーマ症例である。線条状性腺は染色体解析されていないため、検出されなかったモザイクが存在した可能性も否定できない。
